desc: Implement the Trie class/structure using lists for efficiency (children as list of size 26) and write the insertion logic to populate counts for all words.
Initialize an answer array of size `len(words)` with zeros.
Precompute `nodes_k` (list of nodes with count == k, sorted by depth descending) and `max_depth_greater_k` (max depth of any node with count > k).
Iterate through each index `i` from 0 to `n-1`:
Mark nodes on the path of `words[i]` in a set.
Find the deepest valid node: check `max_depth_greater_k` first, then iterate `nodes_k` to find the first node not in the marked set.
Store the maximum valid depth found for index `i` in the answer array.
Verify the solution with provided examples.
Check for any potential performance bottlenecks if constraints were tighter (though current constraints are handled).
